items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODY3MjAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--dbf3d34c5da4ca01b208c122a1448251126b7716/quixeramobimopen2025.jpg)

🇧🇷
Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada. Mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/QuixeramobimOpen2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Por favor leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição, bem como as [Orientações Adicionais](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/guidelines.html).

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a CMCE, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

---

🇺🇸
Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance. More information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/QuixeramobimOpen2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full) before the competition.

By registering, you authorize ABRACM, CMCE, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: Please Be Quiet West Virginia 2025

venue.name: Code Ninjas Eastern Panhandle
venue.address: 217 Oak Lee Dr. Suite 3b, Ranson, WV 25438
venue.details: Located in the Potomac Marketplace, in between the School of Music and Apricot Lane Boutique.

items.information:
Please note the venue is small, and if possible please do not bring guests. We will be enforcing a one guest per competitor policy. Also, although there is a School of Music next door to the venue, they are closed on the day of the competition, so do not worry about there being music playing during the competition.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdmhSIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--870d76ef713f4edc5223895d9e286e7c18138874/Mid_Atlantic_Logo.png)

- Join the **[Tri-State Cubing Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/265800827296908/)** (NJ, NY, PA)
- See the **[Mid-Atlantic Region Organizational Spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a-IPbJv1fA5rsijUHZYLqQmMqnv0Osw8JO0sQMMAWyQ/edit)**

items.name: Cubing-on-Hudson PM 2025

venue.name: James V. Harmon Community Center
venue.details: The event is being held in conjunction with Hastings Recreation Department. Walk in the main door and the room is to your left.

items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab. This competition is a fundraiser for the [Federated Conservationists of Westchester County.](https://www.fcwc.org/)
